representation: Pn(x)=(1/pi)*integral_0^pi [x+i*sqrt(1-x^2)*cos(theta)]^n dtheta. Expanding and using the exact even cosine moments reproduces every Legendre polynomial through degree32.
bound: For real |x|<=1 the squared modulus of the integrand base is x^2+(1-x^2)*cos(theta)^2<=1. Therefore |Pn(x)|<=1, and half the sum of coefficient interval widths bounds the exact midpoint-polynomial coefficient error.
